reviews.review_description: We took up a Sungrid package promoted as part of the "Days of Change" program in Western Australia. Our choice was made after comparing the cost and advertised performance of that package with other packages identified by Solar Quotes and solarchoice.The discounted price of the Sungrid package made it unbeatable, particularly when we took into account the performance specifications of the Sungrid panels. Our system has been installed for less than two weeks, and we have yet to receive our electricity account, but we are pleased with what we have seen of the generating capacity recorded by the Orion inverter. The panels start generating a small amount of power shortly after dawn and, after building up to high levels during the day, they keep working until the sun drops quite low. We have had rain and cloud on some days but, even when the day has been dull, the panels have generated some power.
